src/count-handler.ts.name: Event count requests
src/count-handler.ts.description: Answers how many relay events match a search by asking the host's count service.

src/identity-handler.ts.name: Identity requests
src/identity-handler.ts.description: Passes identity questions (profile, follows, public key) to the host's identity service, or replies with a standard failure.

src/state-handler.ts.name: Napplet storage handler
src/state-handler.ts.description: Saves, reads, lists and removes a napplet's key/value data through the host, enforcing its storage allowance.
